title: Symplectic and projective small covers over products of polygons
summary: We study symplectic and projective structures on small covers over products of polygons. We introduce the factor-compatible class for small covers over products of polygons and prove that every factor-compatible small cover admits a smooth projective model as a finite quotient of a product of curves. Furthermore, we show that the graded mod~$2$ cohomology ring determines the Hodge diamond of the associated projective model. We also prove that every factor-compatible small cover admits an iterated equivariant bundle structure.
